summary:
SphereTeXt is an interactive web application designed to make NASA’s SPHEREx space mission data accessible to everyone. It allows users to explore real infrared observations of the universe and compare images of the same region of space taken at different times.

The website connects to NASA/IPAC’s public astronomical data archive, allowing users to search observations using sky coordinates, dates, and infrared wavelengths. Users can view real astronomical images, explore different wavelength ranges, and compare observations side by side to investigate changes in the sky.

The main goal of SphereTeXt is to make astronomical data easier to understand while helping people discover changes in the universe, such as moving celestial objects and variations in brightness. By providing a simple and interactive interface, the project encourages public participation in space exploration and scientific discovery.

In short: SphereTeXt transforms complex astronomical data into an accessible visual experience, allowing anyone to explore the changing infrared universe.
details:
SphereTeXt is an interactive web application that makes NASA's SPHEREx astronomical data accessible to everyone. Users can search real sky observations, explore infrared wavelengths, filter data by observation dates, view astronomical images, and compare observations from different times to discover changes in the universe.

The project aims to make space exploration easier, more engaging, and accessible to students, researchers, and astronomy enthusiasts. It connects complex scientific data with a simple, user-friendly visual experience.

We developed SphereTeXt using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, connecting it to NASA/IPAC's public IRSA archive and using FITS image processing to display real astronomical observations.

Our creativity lies in turning complex space data into an interactive experience where anyone can explore the changing universe. We considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, usability, and reliable data sources throughout development.
